findings.message: Source identities checked; embedded inductor, bridge and relay documents identified by hash. Other terms and model applicability remain incomplete

q_boost: measured turn-on/turn-off overlap energy and hot RDS(on) curve; the order code is resolved, the transition energy is not; d_boost: forward-drop curve, current sharing and capacitive commutation; l_boost: core and AC winding loss; cmc: hot DC, AC winding and core loss; c1..c4,c_hf: frequency-dependent ESR and current sharing; PCB, connectors, fuse and holder: distributed resistive loss; bypass: contact loss; unbypassed NTC startup/fault loss; pfc and small-signal devices: supply loss excluding already counted relay; bridge: waveform/temperature-dependent forward drop beyond single test point; hot shunt and relay tolerance/temperature corrections
Total loss unknown; 105 W is a prior allowance, not verified cooling capacity. Installed airflow, thermal interfaces and board boundary remain unbound

assumptions: 108/120/132 V and L±20% are sensitivity points, not qualified input limits; ideal CCM, 15 A true RMS, fixed nominal bus/frequency
Input power is not DC output power; current ripple consumes part of the RMS current ceiling
Bridge 1.05 V test point is extrapolated as constant, not a waveform-wide/hot guarantee
Copper alpha20=0.00393/K is assumed; DCR max20mOhm at20C; core/AC loss excluded

The authored and native MPN is STW65N65DM2AG; its physical package marking is 65N65DM2 per the official DS11178 Rev 2 Device summary. The retained local PDF is Rev 1 and is hash-pinned for the other typicals

The 456 pF C_oss eq. is time-equivalent (0..80% VDSS), so it is metadata only. Eoss(VDS) is digitized from DS11178 Rev 2 p. 6 Figure 8 with ±0.6 µJ interpolation uncertainty; typical data are not guarantees

The 10 ohm external plus 3.3 ohm intrinsic gate network and 9..11 V bias sweep imply a first-order 70..86 ns Qgd edge and a nominal overlap sensitivity; UCC28180 source impedance, plateau voltage and layout parasitics still require measured waveforms
UCC28180 loaded ICC (15 V * 7 mA typical) already includes charging its characterized load; it must not be added to full Qg*V*f as independent quiescent power
No equal sharing of SiC anodes or capacitor-bank ripple assumed; no individual package thermal verdict
Prior 60C sink target is not proof of 60C remote PCB boundary
